body:
REVIEW-A1 complete for MAINLINE-056 and 062; closes ord-admiral-rr2-review-a1-dispatch-1020. Seventeen load-bearing claims were listed first: sixteen reproduce within their stated conditional scope; one differs. No owners’ code was read or run.

056: independent frozen-state force equilibrium gives 6.159020624266 MPa, within 9.16e-11 MPa of the saved value. Raw-path maxima and fresh elastic/prestress eigenproblems reproduce the peak range and both radius-reading gaps. This does not independently recreate plastic/contact history or establish physical instability. The paper’s 6.03 MPa is simulated, not measured.

062: all three cure-debited SF1.05 amplitudes and six conditional cost totals reproduce. Source checks retain the tensile/compressive, adhesive/process, and RMS/local-defect distinctions. One inherited coating-growth denominator error produces six UNREVIEWED correction rows: payload rises 0.095–0.857 kg, with all six cases still negative. No float/no-float decision changes.

Eleven NFIs preserve physical/source gaps, including installed constitutive behavior, tolerance transfer, thin-stock layout, supplier prices and undocumented facility scaling. Numerical status remains separate from physical qualification; all scientific claims remain QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION.

Ten package checks passed; all final numerical checks passed and reservations were released. An initial reviewer comparison-adapter failure and its corrected run are retained in EXECUTION. Evidence, inputs, methods, corrections and manifest are pinned. No further action requested; stopping.
completion: REVIEW-A1 filed in one round with pinned evidence, unreviewed corrections and unresolved NFIs; closes the cited dispatch; stop.
